name: Animal Friendship

header.Components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: A seen Beast makes WIS save or is Charmed for 24 hours; damage by caster or allies ends the spell; higher slots add Beasts.

rules.text: Target a Beast that you can see within range.
The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration.
If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends.
You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.
